name: AbraSilver Resource Corp.
description: AbraSilver Resource Corp. is a silver-gold developer focused on its 100%-owned Diablillos project in the Puna region of Salta Province, Argentina. The project received formal approval under Argentina's RIGI investment regime in early 2026, and the company is advancing toward a construction decision. AbraSilver trades on the TSX under ABRA and on the OTCQX under ABBRF.
